items.question: Can offers be combined?
items.answer: No, unless the offer page says so. Each campaign states its own dates and conditions, and one offer applies to a purchase. Exchanging old gold at full weight is a standing promise rather than a campaign offer; ask at the counter how it applies with the offer you have in mind.

items.question: Do offers apply at all branches?
items.answer: Yes, unless the offer page names specific branches. The same offer, the same gold rate and the same promises apply at every Classic Jewels & Diamonds counter in Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. Offers are applied in store, so message us on WhatsApp to check which pieces qualify before you visit.

items.question: How do I claim an offer?
items.answer: Mention the offer at the counter before the invoice is raised, or ask on WhatsApp first and we will confirm which pieces qualify and what the offer covers. Offers run only for the dates stated on the offer page.
